-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

get-user.name: get-user
get-user.description: Get the authenticated ClickUp user information.

get-workspaces.name: get-workspaces
get-workspaces.description: Get all ClickUp workspaces (teams) the user belongs to.

get-members.name: get-members
get-members.description: Get all members of a ClickUp workspace.

get-spaces.name: get-spaces
get-spaces.description: Get all spaces in a ClickUp workspace.

get-folders.name: get-folders
get-folders.description: Get all folders in a ClickUp space.

create-folder.name: create-folder
create-folder.description: Create a new folder in a ClickUp space.

params.spaceId: The space ID where the folder will be created
params.name: Name of the new folder

get-lists.name: get-lists
get-lists.description: Get all lists in a ClickUp folder.

create-list.name: create-list
create-list.description: Create a new list inside a ClickUp folder.

params.folderId: The folder ID where the list will be created
params.name: Name of the new list

get-tasks.name: get-tasks
get-tasks.description: Get tasks from a ClickUp list with optional filters.

params.listId: The list ID to get tasks from
params.orderBy: Field to order by: id, created, updated, due_date (default: created)

get-task.name: get-task
get-task.description: Get detailed information about a specific ClickUp task.

create-task.name: create-task
create-task.description: Create a new task in a ClickUp list.

params.listId: The list ID where the task will be created
params.name: Task name/title
params.priority: Task priority: urgent, high, normal, low
params.status: Task status (must match a status in the list)
params.assignees: Array of user IDs to assign
params.dueDate: Due date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds
params.startDate: Start date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds
params.parentId: Parent task ID to create as a subtask

params.name: New task name
params.priority: New priority: urgent, high, normal, low
params.dueDate: New due date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds
params.startDate: New start date as Unix timestamp in milliseconds

search-tasks.name: search-tasks
search-tasks.description: Search for tasks across a ClickUp workspace.

params.workspaceId: The workspace (team) ID to search in

add-comment.name: add-comment
add-comment.description: Add a comment to a ClickUp task.

params.taskId: The task ID to comment on
params.notifyAll: Notify all assignees of the task (default: false)

get-comments.name: get-comments
get-comments.description: Get all comments on a ClickUp task.

name: ClickUp
description: ClickUp project management - manage tasks, lists, folders, spaces and workspaces via ClickUp API with OAuth2

changelog.notes: Initial release — create, update, search and comment on tasks across ClickUp spaces, folders and lists
